Budget, forecast, actuals, and variance
Availability, durability, latency, and throughput
Compute, storage, network, and licensing

questions.explain: Combining Query Store's per-query CPU/reads with the instance's hourly cost gives directional cost per query pattern — e.g., a report consuming 15% of a $4,000/month instance costs $600/month — ordering the tuning backlog by dollars.
options: Cost attribution is impossible without a dedicated FinOps tool
By dividing the monthly bill by the total query count
By combining Query Store's per-query resource consumption (CPU time, logical reads) with the instance's hourly cost — directional accuracy is enough to prioritize
By tagging each query with a cost-center attribute
